scope: Every manifest Keeper frame is classified. Every standing/sitting frame whose metadata establishes a 90-degree side view is inventoried with source hashes and frame geometry. An eligible beard-mask comparison passes when its symmetric silhouette difference is at most one logical pixel; all candidates without the required comparison evidence fail closed as non-comparable.

beardReference.name: keeper_clear_snow
beardReference.authority: The current authored brief, source-authoring chain, and production contract identify this accepted winter-coat clip as the authoritative fuller stepped right-facing beard.

method.beardSilhouette: An approved normalized beard mask tied to facial landmarks is compared by symmetric silhouette difference. At most one logical pixel may differ and still pass (Frank-approved tolerance); no such cross-pose mask exists in this repository. The canonical self-comparison has delta zero.
method.beardLocation: The required landmark map (eye/nose/chin/head origin) is absent, so location cannot be normalized across canvases or head tilts.
method.occlusion: The flattened PNG/sidecar pair contains no depth or component ownership mask. Colour predicates are explicitly rejected as evidence of hand-over-beard ordering.
method.cellGeometry: PNG width must divide exactly by declared frames; source sidecar and strip SHA-256 values are pinned.
method.transparentGutters: Every audited frame is checked for alpha on all four cell borders; a changed draft would require the same check frame-by-frame.
method.failClosedRule: Missing beard pixels, missing comparison data, or a non-comparable pose is never a pass.
